Name: Farm Building - Watermill (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
The watermill is an 8x4 farm building that processes wood, stone, soggy newspaper, driftwood, fiber and cloth into different kinds of paper.
It can be constructed by Robin for 10,000g, 500 wood, 500 stone, 10 clay and 10 iron bars. 
Outside of the building, there's a slot for item input, as well as an output box for the finished produce. If you're having trouble finding the input slot, check the videos tab of this mod page for a demonstration. The interior is an empty room with space for you to either decorate or use for processing machines or storage.

[b][size=4]Item Processing [/size][/b]
The watermill produces three types of paper. 
The required resources can all be put into the same input slot on the outside of the building, to the right of the door. They are processed overnight and are ready for collection the next day. 

Paper:
10 wood = 20 paper
10 fiber = 10 paper 
Regular paper sells for 20g per piece in year 2+ and for 5g per piece in year 1 (to adjust for lower resource prices). 

Stone paper:
20 stone = 10 stone paper
Stone paper sells for 30g per piece. 

Recycled paper:
1 driftwood = 5 recycled paper
1 soggy newspaper = 5 recycled paper
1 cloth = 20 recycled paper
Recycled paper sells for 50g per piece.

None of the paper types are required to be shipped for perfection.

[b][size=4]Appearance and Permissions[/size][/b]
The watermill has a texture for each season, changing the color of the grass and rocks within the texture, as well as the vine on the wall of the building. During the winter, the roof is covered in snow.
As of right now, there are no recolor options.
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, add items to be processed, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
